messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] GSLB health drop — na-west GPU pool reporting 95% deferred/oom, p50 token latency up 2x. automated policy tripped: mark unhealthy.

maya: seeing large tail latencies and kernel OOMs, started drain of a few p3 nodes. need immediate traffic shift away from na-west to eu-west and na-east fallback.

jamal: agree. propose stepwise weights: canary 10% to eu-west first, then gradual ramp. we should avoid huge spike on eu due to peak. suggest initial eu:na = 30:70.

liam: current capacity in eu-west is limited, but we can spin up reserved burst nodes. cost hit but keeps latency lower than na-east. what's our egress cost impact?

carla: egress to eu will add ~0.7c per request on avg, but na-east cross-az is cheaper. if we move heavy batch workloads to na-east and low-latency traffic to eu, we can optimize.

maya: oncall plan: 1) set GSLB weights to eu-west=0.3 na-east=0.7, ttl=20s; 2) enable canary header X-Route-Policy=evac-canary for 10% traffic; 3) monitor p95 errors <2% and token latency <500ms. will run now.

jamal: running:
```
gslbctl update-weights --policy evict-na-west --set eu-west=0.3,na-east=0.7 --ttl 20
gslbctl set-canary --policy evict-na-west --header 'X-Route-Policy: evac-canary' --percent 10
```

infra-bot: deploy request accepted, change queued, expected propagate 15s.

sophia: +1. FYI I updated console dashboard to show per-route cache hit and kv-warmup. watch for cache-miss spike.

maya: noticed KV cache misses on eu ~5x, enabling prewarm of popular prefixes. running job now.

diego: prewarm done, kv warm-hit ratio up; p95 dropped from 620ms to 320ms. CPU on eu nodes at 78%.

jamal: are we comfortable with egress and cost for next 6 hours? ops approval needed if > $5k/h.

carla: I'll notify finance if we breach $2k/h. try to autoscale reserved burst and drain na-west gracefully.

maya: monitoring. if p95 > 700ms or errors >3% rollback to previous weights. ping me immediately if you see anomalies :eyes: 

infra-bot: change complete. new weights active. propagation timestamp 1851112240. marking thread resolved when stable.
